policy.purpose: Declared finite-study accuracy targets; not universal solver defaults or proof of asymptotic convergence
policy.rationale: Spatial band-shape tolerance resolves a few percent of the ~4e-5 flat bandwidth. Temporal5e-8 limits frequency phase error to~.01rad over the longest plotted duration. Width1a and center.25a are separate observable goals.
